answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 60 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 13 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 60 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 780 bought sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the timber here is verification, the wander of cost is what stops the farm, and the delta of the record keeps every claim checkable.
